entities.summary: Chinese Ming, a notable figure in the history of Brunei, associated with Sultanate of Brunei Golden Age (1368–1485). Preceded by Conversion to Islam and Sultanate Founding and Conversion to Islam and establishment of the Sultanate of Brunei. Their legacy influenced Zenith Under Sultan Bolkiah and Bolkiah.
